title.value: An identification of models to help in the design of national strategies and policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the header of the research paper.
title.quote: An identification of models to help in the design of national strategies and policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

analysis.description: The paper examines various models and strategies employed in Europe to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in the transportation sector. It reviews national strategies and policies by listing models that assist in policy development, focusing on land use and transport interaction (LUTI) models as well as national scale modeling tools. The aim is to gain a better understanding of how methods and tools can assist in decision-making and policy development pertaining to GHG emission reduction goals in the transportation sector.

type.justification: The paper reviews existing models and policies that have been implemented, focusing on empirical data and real-world applications rather than theoretical considerations.
type.quote: we list some of the land use and transport interaction (LUTI) models that can be used to improve climate change control at the urban scale.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on modeling greenhouse gas emissions caused by transportation to assist in national strategies and policies for reduction.
